notes.title: Update 4.23
notes.content:
Hello!
New update 4.23 is available.
We improved the mp3 composer (targets do not cluster anymore).
We also added new languages.
And a new additional arena is available now. 
Hope you like it!😃

notes.title: V 3.89
notes.content:
Hello Players, 
You asked about turning off the drones in standard tracks.
We add this possibility in the new update v3.89

notes.title: MP3 Synchro update.
notes.content:
Hello Players,
In new update 3.73 we fixed problem with synchro in MP3 files.

notes.title: Update 3.71
notes.content:
Hello Players,
We just released update 3.71.
Now you can compose and save 3 different versions of your favorite MP3.

notes.title: Space Arena Update
notes.content:
Christmas is coming, so we make your dreams come true.
You asked for an arena with fewer lights. You got it.
The new 3.58 update has a new arena.
Fewer lights, fewer distractions will allow you to focus on the heat.🤩
We also improved HIT FX for a better indication of the hits.

notes.title: X-BOOSTER is changing into X-FITNESS.
notes.content:
Hello Players,
We released update 3.40.
We decided to change the name! 
X-BOOSTER is changing into X-FITNESS.
We added 5 new songs so now you have 150 workouts ready to play!!!
We also expanded the number of playlist lists and also the size of playlists.
We added the ability to adjust the time offset in the songs.
We expanded the tutorial with video sequences. 
And we added a video that shows how to use MP3 files.

notes.title: Update 3.10 available.
notes.content:
We released update 3.10.
1. Finished the work on optimizing the loading of arenas and mp3 files, thanks to which the transitions are smoother. Selecting mp3 songs in the menu should not cause jams now.
2. Created a new arena.
3. Fixed an issue with bullets clipping through shields.
4. Improved the arena matching algorithm.

notes.title: Update 2.95 available now.
notes.content:
Hello All,
New update 2.95 is available.
We improved hit markers.
We give the possibility to turn off the vertical obstacles.
We also added a new arena.

notes.title: The new version 2.82 is available now.
notes.content:
Hello All,
The new version 2.82 is available now.

We added:
- new sequences to the composer, also more jabs:),
- the possibility of converting vertical obstacles into blocks, 
- the ability to edit all playlists and rename them,
- the possibility of changing the names of the profiles,
- the ability to adjust the SFX volume.
 

We improved shield collisions.
We have more than doubled the time of the generated MP3 workouts.
We balanced scores for different modes.
We improved the calories counter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37768206/a0d806c60218bda1b95a12e70226b01c859f3856.png[/img]

notes.title: Performance fix.
notes.content:
We released version 2.30 where we fixed some performance issues.
We are sorry and we hope this will help anyone who experienced problems in version 2.26.

notes.title: Version 2.26.
notes.content:
Hi Players,
We just released the update ver 2.26 where we focused on the composer.
We improved it and added:
- the ability to edit programs that have more than 10 tracks
- the possibility to add random lists
- the possibility of skipping the tracks.
We also added new languages: Korean, Japan, Chinese.

notes.title: X-Booster Out Of Early Access
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
We are happy to announce that today “X-BOOSTER” is out of Early Access.
However, we continue to develop the game. 
New updates with programs edition and LIV support should appear soon.
We would like to say a BIG THANK YOU  to everyone who helped in the development of the game with their commitment, observations, and comments.
Have fun!:)

notes.title: New MP3 Composer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37768206/95c92172ff42f4b995aaa62730c2658472697edf.png[/img]
Use your mp3 files and create your own workouts. We have added the ability to adjust the style of generated workouts. Now you can choose if you want more or fewer obstacles. Do you just prefer hitting or mix.

notes.title: v 1.4 with MP3 Composer.
notes.content:
Welcome

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37768206/65f5efc84289ab1ac9e93f1fe7db574889c98a14.png[/img]
Being aware that you are waiting for the possibility of playing with your own music, we decided to publish the first version of the automatic exercise creation system for your favorite music in mp3 files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37768206/2dd397486af0e038c6e4f6e98f766621b6adeb06.png[/img]
We know that the composer is not perfect and we intend to further improve and expand it.
However, it is important to us that you can test the current version.

Music analysis is not a simple matter and the algorithm will not cope with all types of music, but we hope you will find one that you will enjoy.

Best Regards
NiVision
